items.title: The Picard stack is a gerbe over the Picard functor
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file moduli.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Prove Picardstack_{X/B} -> Picardfunctor_{X/B} is a gerbe: check conditions (2)(a) and (2)(b) of the when-gerbe lemma following quot-lemma-pic-over-pic with the fppf sheafification spelled out - (2)(a): a section xi of the Picard functor locally corresponds to an invertible module L_i on X_{U_i} by the defining fppf sheaf property, giving objects (U_i -> B, L_i) above xi|_{U_i}; (2)(b): two invertible modules mapping to the same functor element become isomorphic on an fppf cover, giving local isomorphisms of the corresponding stack objects.
